name: @ziner/app-desktop
author: Ziner Team
description: V2 Desktop App — cross-platform Electron host for the Ziner Runtime.

scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/index.ts --bundle --outfile=out/renderer/bundle.js --format=iife --global-name=ZApp --loader:.ts=ts 2>&1 && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/renderer/index.html', 'out/renderer/index.html'); require('fs').cpSync('src/renderer/styles.css', 'out/renderer/styles.css'); require('fs').cpSync('src/renderer/agent-viewport.html', 'out/renderer/agent-viewport.html'); if (require('fs').existsSync('src/assets')) require('fs').cpSync('src/assets', 'out/assets', {recursive: true})"
scripts.start: node scripts/build-deps.js && npm run build && node ../../node_modules/electron/cli.js .
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run prepackage && node ../../node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js
